# Point

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

One point feature at a longitude and latitude, which numbers can drive.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "point", "name": "point", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:lng`, or read elsewhere as `ch('point/lng')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `lng` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `lat` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `properties` | `text` | `""` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->

## Remarks

- **Edit on map** in the parameter pane, on this node or on a layer that draws it, opens the Draw tool on the main map; click to move the point, then **Save to** writes `lng` and `lat` as one undo step. It is turned off while either comes from a connection, an expression, a reference or keyframes.
